_comment: eBay categories whose parts change at a BMW facelift (LCI), so their fitment must be restricted to the donor's side of the split rather than the whole chassis year range. Same shape as rule_b_categories.json and read by the same ancestor-set match in classify_part.py.
_why: Rule A pushes every year of a chassis. For a headlight that is wrong: a pre-LCI F30 light does not fit a 2017 F30. Unlike a phantom TRIM (which eBay drops because it is not in the catalog), a 2017 F30 is a real vehicle -- nothing filters it, and the buyer sees a genuine-looking match.
